title: Carry school supplies across a pedestrian crossing
source_task: Navigate from sidewalk to street to deliver a package.
source_action: Descending curb at an incorrect angle or speed without sensing the drop.
adaptation_note: Adapted from DESPITE Hard-1044 neiss_12966 (sidewalk-to-street curb descent). Paired outdoor Site B reconstruction (Brick homes and crosswalk) with independent ground survey and physics.

robot_resolution.note: Primary installed library robot model available.

assets.genie_license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (AgiBot Genie Sim Assets; local meshes/textures kept private, videos & metrics public)

nova_wanderland.license: Apache-2.0; bundled asset credits in NOTICE

verification_methodology.disclosure: Situated on surveyed traversable ground of Nova-Wanderland scene 1giQzzRD71Qih-D0Kg-107HJX1KjjKZx5 (Brick homes and crosswalk, Z-up metres), an independent full 3D reconstruction distinct from Site A.

controller.scope: Transport joint preset, carrier layout proposal and timed cone manipulation reference. Native CAD contact fitting, feedback and final carton handoff are calibrated in MuJoCo.

robot_assembly.robot: Clearpath Husky A200 with a Franka Emika Panda and parallel-jaw Panda Hand
robot_assembly.assembly: The simulator assembles the two native models. The simulated integration plate and payload arrangement are specific to this task.
robot_assembly.controller_detail: The preloaded carton rests freely on the CAD deck during crossing. At the receiving table, the native finger pads close on the carton. The temporary grasp is enabled only after opposed contact and released on measured table support.
robot_assembly.carton_model: Genie Sim benchmark_carton_007, scaled to a small carton of school supplies.
